name: SVC_CATEGORIES_BACKUP_
description: This table is used to store the list of categories that the SR belongs to. Categories can be hierarchical.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_CATEGORIES(CATEGORY_ID). Defines category hierarchy by storing the parent category ID, or null if this is a root category.

columns.name: CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Specifies the name of the category.

columns.name: CATEGORY_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Auto-generated from CATEGORY_NAME when new, but can be updated to make this value unique or for any other purpose.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Specifies the original system reference if record was imported.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is enabled (Y or N).

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CSS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is visible in CSS portal (Y or N).

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM or HCM.

columns.name: BU_ORG_ID
columns.description: Stores the Business Unit Org Id of the category.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
